product.name: Aurora Aurum Veler Effect Tongue & Groove Waterproof Shower Wall Panel (H)2420mm (W)1180mm
product.description:
The Aurora boards are a sleek, modern alternative to traditional tiling, offering the perfect combination of design and durability. Made with a 100% waterproof synthetic homogenous foam blend core, they are not only water-resistant but also a more environmentally conscious option compared to polymer-based boards.

Once installed, Aurora boards require minimal upkeep. Simply wipe them down with a damp cloth to keep them looking fresh. The non-porous surface prevents water retention, helping to eliminate issues like mould and bacteria growth often associated with traditional tiles.

Transform your shower, bathroom, or kitchen with this low maintenance, sleek waterproof wall panel. Measuring 2420mm in height and a generous 1180mm wide, that can be cut down to your required size, these panels offer a perfect fit for any space, providing both practicality and style.

The tongue & groove connection ensures a seamless, easy-to-assemble installation with no grouting needed! The panels simply click together to create a smooth watertight finish with no long drying time required.

The waterproof & mould-resistant surface is ideal for wet areas like showers and bathrooms that can be easily cleaned after each use. 

These stylish, high-quality panels are designed to provide a modern, clean finish to your space while being incredibly easy to install and maintain. Say goodbye to grout and mould with this perfect solution for a fast and fresh update!

product.name: Aurora Aurum Veler Effect Tongue & Groove Waterproof Shower Wall Panel (H)2420mm (W)1180mm
product.description:
The Aurora boards are a sleek, modern alternative to traditional tiling, offering the perfect combination of design and durability. Made with a 100% waterproof synthetic homogenous foam blend core, they are not only water-resistant but also a more environmentally conscious option compared to polymer-based boards.

Once installed, Aurora boards require minimal upkeep. Simply wipe them down with a damp cloth to keep them looking fresh. The non-porous surface prevents water retention, helping to eliminate issues like mould and bacteria growth often associated with traditional tiles.

Transform your shower, bathroom, or kitchen with this low maintenance, sleek waterproof wall panel. Measuring 2420mm in height and a generous 1180mm wide, that can be cut down to your required size, these panels offer a perfect fit for any space, providing both practicality and style.

The tongue & groove connection ensures a seamless, easy-to-assemble installation with no grouting needed! The panels simply click together to create a smooth watertight finish with no long drying time required.

The waterproof & mould-resistant surface is ideal for wet areas like showers and bathrooms that can be easily cleaned after each use. 

These stylish, high-quality panels are designed to provide a modern, clean finish to your space while being incredibly easy to install and maintain. Say goodbye to grout and mould with this perfect solution for a fast and fresh update!

product.name: Aurora Aurum Veler Effect Tongue & Groove Waterproof Shower Wall Panel (H)2420mm (W)1180mm
product.description:
The Aurora boards are a sleek, modern alternative to traditional tiling, offering the perfect combination of design and durability. Made with a 100% waterproof synthetic homogenous foam blend core, they are not only water-resistant but also a more environmentally conscious option compared to polymer-based boards.

Once installed, Aurora boards require minimal upkeep. Simply wipe them down with a damp cloth to keep them looking fresh. The non-porous surface prevents water retention, helping to eliminate issues like mould and bacteria growth often associated with traditional tiles.

Transform your shower, bathroom, or kitchen with this low maintenance, sleek waterproof wall panel. Measuring 2420mm in height and a generous 1180mm wide, that can be cut down to your required size, these panels offer a perfect fit for any space, providing both practicality and style.

The tongue & groove connection ensures a seamless, easy-to-assemble installation with no grouting needed! The panels simply click together to create a smooth watertight finish with no long drying time required.

The waterproof & mould-resistant surface is ideal for wet areas like showers and bathrooms that can be easily cleaned after each use. 

These stylish, high-quality panels are designed to provide a modern, clean finish to your space while being incredibly easy to install and maintain. Say goodbye to grout and mould with this perfect solution for a fast and fresh update!
